macros.name: addmarking
macros.doc: \addmarking{⟨level⟩}{⟨marking⟩}{⟨heading⟩} will set the marking and heading at the given level.

envs.name: marking box
envs.doc: The marking box environment will wrap the item in a colored box and place the heading in the upper left and lower right corners of the box in the same color as the box.
